team_holdout.description: held teams: NorthStar, SQUIRTLE (prime), THIRD PTCG Club, Yushin Ito

runtime_metadata.name: alakazam_ml_v10
runtime_metadata.model: LightGBM candidate ranker distilled to pure Python trees
runtime_metadata.model_scope: The v8 ranker is copied unchanged and remains shadow-only by default. Deterministic v9 rule authority owns Hammer targeting/reservation, Fezandipiti modes, evolution target choice, Boss, attack, retreat, and end. Guarded bench override experiments require an explicit environment variable.
runtime_metadata.deck_policy: Deck fixed from v8: 3 Dunsparce / 2 Dudunsparce / 1 Shaymin, retaining Max Rod ACE, 2 basic Psychic, 4 Telepath Psychic, Fezandipiti ex, 4 Enhanced Hammer, and 3 Boss's Orders.

ladder_fix_basis.source: 92 v5 Kaggle ladder replays from submissions 54788067 and 54795292
rules: never activate Dudunsparce when it is the only Pokemon in play
replace Genesect, Lucky Helmet, and one basic Psychic Energy with three Boss's Orders
play Boss only when it creates a same-turn KO on a strategically superior Bench target
prioritize Team Rocket's Articuno and effect-protection engines when they are KO-able
never replace an equal or better Active KO with a lower-value Bench KO
retrain the shadow ranker on the same 92 replays without granting live override authority

model_training_update.source: 10 top21-40 Alakazam rank ZIPs containing 16 submissions

v9_evidence.v8_mist_matchup_first_hammer_problem: Only about one third of v8 Hammers in Mist matchups selected Mist; Majkel selected Mist first in 171/184 games (92.9%).
v9_evidence.v8_fez_active_problem: Fezandipiti ex was Active in 12 games, never received Energy and never attacked; seven games had a long Active stall.

v9_rule_changes: Resolve Enhanced Hammer energyIndex targets and prefer Mist/effect-prevention Energy
Reserve the final Enhanced Hammer for inferred Mist decks unless another target creates immediate attack denial or a KO
Classify Fezandipiti ex as DO_NOT_BENCH, DRAW_ONLY, PIVOT, or ALTERNATE_ATTACKER
Permit one-Energy Fezandipiti pivot escape and matchup-only Cruel Arrow development
Choose Active versus Bench Kadabra dynamically instead of using an absolute side preference
Require two-hit Boss routes to be sticky, prize-closing, and explicitly high value
Record action-level Hammer, Fezandipiti, Kadabra, Boss, and stall diagnostics
v8_rule_changes: Use current Team Rocket's Articuno card ID 414 instead of stale Lunatone ID 675
Prefer Bench Abra for Kadabra evolution when Active and Bench are both legal, except an immediate Active Kadabra KO
Allow a tightly gated two-hit Boss route to a multi-prize target in an urgent prize race
Prioritize KO-able Froslass engines and limit extra Dunsparce engine bodies under Froslass
Add one Shaymin for attack-based bench-damage matchups while retaining Max Rod

v8_training_update.source: submission 54811136 plus the complete v7 corpus
v8_training_update.decision: adopt as shadow ranker; do not expand live authority beyond guarded bench experiments
